text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон dominates at the Osaka
Hai! The
Queen of the Amazons is better
than ever, and
her incredible running
reflects that!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She responds to the cheering audience
with pride.
Next on her list is winning
first place at the
Yasuda Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
